contact.title: Need Help?
contact.supportText: The fastest way to get help with any Feeltracker app is to email support@feeltracker.com — we're a small team and usually reply within 24 hours. Tell us which app you're using and what you were doing when the problem happened, and we'll take it from there.
contact.faqText: For step-by-step answers on syncing, backups, exporting for your doctor, AI features, privacy and subscriptions, see our FAQ page.
